title: Native Home interface

concepts.status: Design mockups with synthetic data; not native TV captures or implemented capability

Home.purpose: Immediate access to favourites and inputs
composition: Header with time/date and device-state summary
Horizontally scrolling favourite application shelf using shared cards::Shelf
Four HDMI input cards with separate plug/signal states
Control-centre entry and return to LG Home
Home.initial_focus: Last deliberate favourite or first available favourite

composition: Context menu for dashboard-only pin/order preferences
Applications.source: Authoritative launch points joined to app metadata
Applications.identity: Stable application ID; keys survive refresh and rename

composition: Input name and format when available
Inputs.activation: Typed source-selection request through LG application manager; no decoder replacement

Controls.purpose: One native entry point for settings
composition: Native value rows and choice/range widgets
Current input / dynamic range / picture-mode breadcrumb
Visible capability state and LG Settings fallback

interaction.arrows: Shared focus engine and card/form components
interaction.ok: Commit the action owned by the focused item
interaction.back: Close overlay, return to parent, then exit at root
interaction.pointer: Shared hit map; focus by current item identity

style.animations: Short transform/opacity transitions with bounded render caches
style.idle: Render only on meaningful changes; hidden app suspends activity
style.reference: Apple TV / tvOS feel, following the native PlxNative interpretation
principles: Large, readable cards and restrained chrome
Smooth spatial focus movement with a clear foreground selection
Simple Back hierarchy and limited choices on each surface
Native components and animations; no WebView
Home places favourites and clearly labelled HDMI status together; focus supplies the emphasis

protected: OLED protection changes and compensation scheduling

data_boundary.root_access: Restricted local helper only, after peer/caller validation
data_boundary.ui: Unprivileged application; no generic shell or arbitrary Luna calls
data_boundary.staleness: Context changes invalidate old setting values and pending actions
data_boundary.root_helper_installation: No automatic boot hook; separate staged proof

reuse.native_ui: plx_ui with plx_gfx, plx_machine, plx_platform and plx_base
reuse.tv_compatibility: Glasshouse as audited API/semantic reference; MIT attribution retained if code is ported
reuse.upstream_shape: Optional independent native Home example plus small generic UI improvements; stable Plex app unchanged

verification.host: Catalogue safety, focus identity, context invalidation, protected actions
verification.visual: Native simulator captures inspected at couch text sizes
verification.device: Isolated package; native frames, physical input, runtime/memory and removal checks on webOS 24
verification.proof_boundary: Earlier C renderer results do not transfer to this new reused-UI build
